standard_prerequisites.use: Statement lines 2162-2164: O is a sheaf of rings on C_total and K is an object of D^+(O).

standard_prerequisites.name: The Cech complex for modules on the total site
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 2180-2189: the horizontal arrows of the double complex come from this lemma; the rows are exact in positive degrees and evaluate to Gamma(C_total, I^q) in degree 0, using Gamma = Hom(O_D, -) on modules.

standard_prerequisites.name: Exactness of restriction and acyclicity of restricted injectives
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 2192-2196: restriction to C_p is exact, so I_p^bullet represents K_p in D(C_p); the I_p^q are totally acyclic on C_p.

standard_prerequisites.name: The homological-algebra machinery
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Homology, Lemma \label{homology-lemma-double-complex-gives-resolution}, Derived Categories, Lemma \label{derived-lemma-leray-acyclicity}, Cohomology on Sites, Lemma \label{sites-cohomology-lemma-limp-acyclic}, Homology, Lemma \label{homology-lemma-first-quadrant-ss}
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 2190-2205: the total complex computes RGamma(C_total, K); column cohomology is computed by Leray's acyclicity; the first-quadrant spectral sequence lemma concludes.

core_obligations: The double complex (proof lines 2176-2191): take a bounded-below complex of injective O-modules I^bullet representing K and set A^{p,q} = Gamma(C_p, I^q_p); the horizontal arrows come from the modules Cech lemma and the vertical ones from the differentials of I^bullet; since Gamma(D, -) = Hom(O_D, -) on modules, the rows are exact in positive degrees with degree-0 value Gamma(C_total, I^q), so the associated total complex computes RGamma(C_total, K) by the double-complex resolution lemma.

The columns (lines 2192-2198): restriction to C_p is exact, so I_p^bullet represents K_p; the terms I_p^q are totally acyclic on C_p; hence the cohomology of the columns computes the groups H^q(C_p, K_p) by Leray's acyclicity lemma and the limp-acyclicity lemma.

Conclusion (lines 2199-2205): applying the first-quadrant spectral sequence lemma yields the spectral sequence with E_1^{p,q} = H^q(C_p, K_p) and d_1 : E_1^{p,q} -> E_1^{p+1,q}, converging to H^{p+q}(C_total, K).
proof_roadmap: Build the double complex of sectionwise injective cohomology and identify its rows via the modules Cech complex.
Identify the column cohomology with the component cohomology groups via exactness of restriction and total acyclicity.
Conclude with the first-quadrant spectral sequence lemma.
